name: MQTT Explorer
author: NucleoOS
description: See what flows on your MQTT broker: topics as they arrive, payloads with JSON pretty-printed, a short history per topic, publish test messages. Uses the broker set in Settings > Home.

descriptions.en: See what flows on your MQTT broker: topics as they arrive, payloads with JSON pretty-printed, a short history per topic, publish test messages. Uses the broker set in Settings > Home.
descriptions.it: Guarda cosa passa sul tuo broker MQTT: i topic man mano che arrivano, i contenuti con il JSON formattato, una breve cronologia per topic, invio di messaggi di prova. Usa il broker impostato in Impostazioni > Casa.
